name: Scarlet Raven Tavern
summary: In Darkshire, Scarlet Raven Tavern is the town’s primary inn and gathering place. Tavernkeep Smitts welcomes weary locals, passing adventurers and frightened travelers seeking shelter from the horrors beyond town.

sections.title: A Dim Refuge
sections.body:
The Scarlet Raven Tavern offers a dim refuge in Darkshire, where the hearth burns beneath the forest’s eternal dusk. Years ago, Marshal Haggard and the Stormwind Guard stopped here for pints after patrols. Since then, business has dwindled as the town’s security has weakened.

Tavernkeep Smitts tends the bar for a somber, anxious crowd seeking warmth against the cold and fear. The inn remains a place to trade rumors and a starting point for travelers seeking answers about the dark forces consuming the region.

sections.title: Secrets and Stolen Pints
sections.body:
Jitters rented a room at the Scarlet Raven for several days. By night, the reclusive wanderer filled his journal with frantic notes, then fled town ahead of the Dark Riders.

Old gossip and guest records kept beneath the tavern also hold ties to figures such as Stalvan Mistmantle. Those who investigate Duskwood’s restless dead begin their search in Smitts’ taproom.

faq.q: Who runs the Scarlet Raven Tavern?
faq.answer: Tavernkeep Smitts runs the Scarlet Raven Tavern. An innkeeper and other staff also serve travelers in Darkshire.

faq.q: Why is the tavern's atmosphere so gloomy?
faq.answer: The curse over Duskwood has choked trade routes and terrified the locals. Undead, feral worgen and shadowy riders prowl the woods, so frightened townsfolk and desperate mercenaries fill the tavern instead of carefree travelers.

faq.q: Did Jitters stay at the Scarlet Raven?
faq.answer: Jitters stayed at the Scarlet Raven Tavern and filled his journal with frantic notes before fleeing town. His reasons emerge during the investigation into Duskwood.

faq.q: What connection does this tavern have to the Legend of Stalvan?
faq.answer: Old patrons and town records preserved in and around the tavern hold clues about Stalvan Mistmantle. He once frequented the settlement before tragedy and infamy claimed him.

angles.text: For Alliance travelers crossing the southern border, the Scarlet Raven offers one of the few safe hearths and resting places between Elwynn Forest and Deadwind Pass.
The inn serves regional delicacies such as Dusky Crab Cakes, a local staple that desperate wanderers like Jitters crave even while hiding in the graveyard.
